title: UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi) tourist visa for Indian passport holders
body: Indian citizens need a visa before travelling to the UAE. A 30-day single-entry tourist visa costs about INR 7,500 and takes 3 to 5 working days. Holders of a valid US visa or green card can get a 14-day visa on arrival.

title: Singapore visa for Indian passport holders
body: Indian citizens need an e-visa for Singapore, applied for through an authorised agent. Processing takes about 4 working days and the fee is around INR 2,400. The passport must be valid for 6 months after arrival.

title: United Kingdom Standard Visitor visa
body: Indian citizens need a Standard Visitor visa for the UK. The 6-month visa costs about GBP 127 and a decision usually takes 3 weeks, so apply at least a month before travel.

title: Thailand entry rules for Indian passport holders
body: Indian citizens can enter Thailand visa-free for up to 60 days for tourism. Carry proof of onward travel and proof of funds of at least THB 10,000 per person.

title: Passport validity rule
body: Most countries in this guide require a passport valid for at least 6 months beyond the date of arrival and with two blank pages. Airlines can refuse boarding if the passport does not meet this.

title: IndiGo international baggage allowance
body: IndiGo international economy fares include 30 kg checked baggage to Dubai and 20 kg to Singapore and Bangkok, plus one 7 kg cabin bag. Extra baggage is cheaper when booked online in advance.

title: Emirates economy baggage allowance
body: Emirates economy fares from India include 25 kg checked baggage on Saver, 30 kg on Flex and 35 kg on Flex Plus, plus one 7 kg cabin bag.

title: Air India international baggage allowance
body: Air India international economy fares include 25 kg checked baggage on Value fares and 30 kg on Flex fares, plus one 7 kg cabin bag. Flights to the UK allow two pieces of 23 kg each.

title: Singapore Airlines economy baggage allowance
body: Singapore Airlines economy fares include 25 kg checked baggage on Lite, 30 kg on Value and 35 kg on Flexi, plus one 7 kg cabin bag.

title: British Airways and Virgin Atlantic baggage allowance
body: Economy fares on British Airways and Virgin Atlantic between India and London include one 23 kg checked bag, a 10 kg cabin bag and a small personal item. Hand-baggage-only fares include no checked bag.

title: Domestic baggage allowance in India
body: Domestic economy fares on IndiGo and Air India include 15 kg checked baggage and one 7 kg cabin bag. Excess baggage is charged per kilogram at the airport.

title: Liquids and power banks in cabin baggage
body: Liquids in cabin baggage must be in containers of 100 ml or less inside one clear resealable bag. Power banks and spare lithium batteries must go in cabin baggage, never in checked baggage, and must be under 100 Wh.

title: Airport check-in times
body: Arrive 3 hours before an international departure and 2 hours before a domestic one. Check-in counters close 60 minutes before international flights and 45 minutes before domestic flights.

title: Changing or cancelling a saved trip
body: A trip saved in this assistant is a plan, not a ticket. No payment is taken and no seat is held. To change a plan, save a new trip; saved trips cannot be edited by the assistant.

title: Travelling with children
body: Children under 2 travel as infants on an adult's lap for about 10 percent of the adult fare and get 10 kg of checked baggage. Children aged 2 to 11 need their own seat and usually pay 75 to 90 percent of the adult fare.

title: Travel insurance
body: Travel insurance is not mandatory for the UAE, Singapore or Thailand but is strongly recommended. The UK does not require it for a visitor visa. A typical 7-day policy for one adult costs INR 500 to 1,200.

title: Red-eye and overnight flights
body: A red-eye flight departs late at night and arrives early the next morning. In this guide, any flight departing between 22:00 and 04:59 counts as a red-eye.

title: Dubai airport transfers
body: Dubai International Airport is connected to the city by the Metro Red Line from Terminals 1 and 3, running about every 10 minutes from 05:00 to midnight. A taxi to Downtown Dubai takes about 20 minutes.
